zh: 拜茨 巴斯特 波……

#en: What can I do for ya?

zh: 明克 莫平 奥普 伊普……
伊什 达 斯梅奇 斯梅德……？
通用物资空投即将抵达！
通用物资空投即将抵达！
格鲁德 促伊 亚奥……
我还没准备好面对这个。
斯梅克斯特 什麦姆 贝本巴……
什明斯 安德 斯梅德尔斯……
桑苏马尔 萨萨 什……

#en: I'd be happy to do that.

zh: 通用物资空投即将抵达……

#en: I'm happy to lend a hand.
I'm happy to lend a hand!

zh: 我正在读取你的信号弹……

#en: How did you find the Post?
zh: 你是怎么找到监听哨的？
你在塞多尼亚过得开心吗？

#en: Sure, no skin off my nose.
Hey, good job! You got it.
Got a read on the flare...
Time to have a little fun!
All you had to do was ask.
Get ready for a fast drop!
Wait, how did you find me?
zh: 等等，你是怎么找到我的？

#en: Do I really need a Skydrop?
Yeah, we owe you one, Gren!
zh: 是啊，我们欠你一次，格伦！

#en: Thanks a lot for your help.
Glad to see you well again.
There is always much to do.
Hey! Got some news for you.

zh: 正好在我们预料的位置。
正在接收你的遥测数据……

#en: Good to see you too, Torin.
That's what I like to hear!
You can trust me with that.
Find a place to take cover!

zh: 马上加急通用物资空投！

#en: So, same plan as last time?
Our weapons are good to go!
I hope you make use of this.

zh: 我有一些物品可供出售。

#en: Hey, wanted a word with you!

zh: 第一个搞定。下一个开关！

#en: Right where we left it, huh?
zh: 就在我们留下的地方，嗯？
欢迎来到星坞宇普西隆！
欢迎来到星坞奥米克戎！
欢迎来到星坞艾普西隆！

#en: I think you might like this!

zh: 汉森南 拉拉乌……？！霍斯？！

#en: It's good to see you, Torin.

zh: 托林，我注意到你的飞船……

#en: Of course, I've got the time.
There you go. All patched up!
Still, I'll share what I can.
I'll take care of any damage.

zh: 好了，享受你的新空投吧。

#en: Then let's work on your ship.
zh: 那我们就来处理你的飞船。

#en: Is this a social call, or...?
I'm ready to go when you are.
I feel like a superhero here!
zh: 我在这儿感觉像个超级英雄！
还以为你不会问呢，舰长！
正在开火！准备承受冲击！
梅莱文 汉…… 特鲁 拉伊……
谢谢 阿拉福 阿雷苏……

#en: They'll first need to find me.
Do I detect a hint of sarcasm?
zh: 我是不是听出一点讽刺？

#en: He's the one I told you about.
zh: 他就是我跟你说过的那个人。

#en: All done. You're in the clear.
I don't want to hear any more.
Oh! Almost forgot to tell you.
So close, one more will do it!
zh: 就差一点，再来一个就行！
这次跃迁有什么新情况吗？

#en: Are we all set? Any questions?
zh: 都准备好了吗？有问题吗？
你不是该被剁成肉酱了吗……？

#en: Hello. May I be of assistance?
I thought you might like this.
zh: 我想你可能会喜欢这个。

#en: All geared up and ready to go.
zh: 全部装备完毕，准备出发。

#en: All weapons are ready to fire.
Strike Flare is on my rader...
zh: 打击信号弹已在我雷达上……
拉里 坎纳 诺尔 莫—— 穆姆……？

#en: How do you make these Skydrops?
zh: 这些空投你是怎么造的？

#en: Did you find a suitable vessel?
zh: 你找到合适的飞船了吗？

#en: She's the one I told you about.
zh: 她就是我跟你说过的那个人。

#en: Um, so, who's your friend here?
zh: 呃，那么，你这位朋友是谁？

#en: Ask away. I'll answer if I can.
Thanks, I'll keep that in mind.

zh: 瞭望塔的事就说到这儿。

#en: I want to unlock a new Skydrop.
This will only take a moment...
No, I'm done with this for now.
I'm sorry, was I boring you...?
zh: 抱歉，是我让你觉得无聊了吗……？

#en: Oh, the mech. I totally forgot!
zh: 哦，那台机甲。我完全忘了！

#en: Get away from that thing! Now!!
But, I got a solution for that!
Hold on... how did YOU find me?
zh: 等等……你是怎么找到我的？

#en: Weapons are all primed to fire!
Weapon should be ready to fire.
That weapon's good to go, boss!
Let's blow 'em out of the void!
Got a present for you, Captain!
Our weapons are primed to fire!
I'm ready at the gunner's seat!
Need a hand? I'm happy to help.
All the weapons are good to go!
Our weapons are up and running.
zh: 我们的武器已上线运行。

#en: Got your Flare, loud and clear.
zh: 你的信号弹收到了，清清楚楚。

#en: Just be ready with my credits...
No ship yet, I'll be back later.
zh: 还没找到飞船，我晚点再来。

#en: Huh. So you found her after all.
Huh. So you found him after all.
What are your thoughts on Akila?
There, that should clear you up.
zh: 好了，这样你应该就没事了。

#en: Ah, you must be Harper's friend.
zh: 啊，你一定是哈珀的朋友。

#en: Does this Amp strike your fancy?
I hope you found it educational.
zh: 希望它让你学到些东西。
瞭望塔到底是做什么的？
有什么事需要我处理吗？
[查看商店] 有什么可买的？

#en: Can you make me these Neuroamps?
zh: 你能给我做这些神经增幅器吗？

#en: You wanna get going? Fine by me!
Good job! Keep the power coming!
I'll land and find the facility.
zh: 我会着陆并找到那座设施。

#en: Now, let's get down to business!
Weapons are good to go, Captain!
Our weapons are prepped to fire!
zh: 我们的武器已备好待发！
*嘎吱* 检测到支援信号弹。
汉兹 苏 胡阿 阿亚努？！哈？！

#en: Time for some action? I like it!
I'll bring you more Intel Slates.
zh: 我会给你带更多情报数据板。

#en: We should have been more careful.
Remind me, how do you know Torin?
zh: 再提醒我，你怎么认识托林的？

#en: Very well. We'll be waiting here.
Yes, I have a ship I want to use.
zh: 对，我有一艘想用的飞船。

#en: Huh. So you found them after all.
They're the one I told you about.
zh: 他们就是我跟你说过的人。

#en: Harper is an old friend of yours?
Mind if I ask you some questions?
zh: 介意我问你几个问题吗？

#en: Let's see what you have in stock.
*sigh* Okay. So, what will it be?
I am occupied, but I will listen.
Seemed like the best thing to do.
Why do you always ask me that...?
There. That should clear our way.
zh: 好了。这样应该能清出路来。

#en: Land ship, find facility. Got it.
Ready to make it happen, skipper!
